thread:
Nina K: Quick sync: our hosted->dedicated->private fallback tests exposed inconsistent header behavior and opaque 429s. Need a tiny spec for adapters.
Rahul D: Saw it too. Dedicated rewrote Authorization to a routed bearer and private expected original API key. It fell back to anonymous and returned 403.
Zoe H: Proposal: treat Authorization, X-Client-ID as canonical and immutable across hops unless an explicit transform handshake occurs. Transform handshake = set X-RW-Identity-Orig + X-RW-Identity-Method and emit audit.
Nina K: Agree. Also namespace internal headers as X-RW- to avoid LB rewrites.
Rahul D: Rate limits: hosted=api-key, dedicated=tenant, private=deployment. Who wins? I propose earliest-deny wins (closest to execution), but if upstream denies first, surface that origin to client with X-RW-Rate-Origin.
Zoe H: Edge-case: upstream rate-check timeout. For auth: fail-closed. For rate-check RPC errors: fail-open + add X-RW-Ratecheck-Error and metric.
infra-bot: note: please add adapter manifest field `mutates_identity: true|false` so linters can catch undocumented transforms.
Nina K: Next steps: Rahul will update dedicated router tests; Zoe will add manifest lint; I'll update the shim RFC with these wire rules. Reconvene after PRs. :thumbsup:
